title: quick glassy tunisian pilaf
description: umami, glassy-jelly tunisian dish featuring chilli flakes, ice-bath-shock, paleo-friendly. a flavorful and quick weeknight meal

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a good quality oil for best flavor

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use sea salt or kosher salt

ingredients.name: rice
ingredients.notes: short-grain rice is best for this dish

instructions: heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
add the chilli flakes and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
add the chicken broth, salt, and black pepper. bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover.
add the rice and sliced almonds to the skillet, stirring to combine.
increase heat to high and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the lemon juice.
transfer the pilaf to a heat-proof bowl and plunge into an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
